> **ACCORDING TO FLORIDA’S CONSTRUCTION LIEN LAW (SECTIONS 713.001-713.37, FLORIDA STATUTES), THOSE WHO WORK ON YOUR PROPERTY OR PROVIDE MATERIALS AND SERVICES AND ARE NOT PAID IN FULL HAVE A RIGHT TO ENFORCE THEIR CLAIM FOR PAYMENT AGAINST YOUR PROPERTY. THIS CLAIM IS KNOWN AS A CONSTRUCTION LIEN. IF YOUR CONTRACTOR OR A SUBCONTRACTOR FAILS TO PAY SUBCONTRACTORS, SUB-SUBCONTRACTORS, OR MATERIAL SUPPLIERS, THOSE PEOPLE WHO ARE OWED MONEY MAY LOOK TO YOUR PROPERTY FOR PAYMENT, EVEN IF YOU HAVE ALREADY PAID YOUR CONTRACTOR IN FULL. IF YOU FAIL TO PAY YOUR CONTRACTOR, YOUR CONTRACTOR MAY ALSO HAVE A LIEN ON YOUR PROPERTY. THIS MEANS IF A LIEN IS FILED YOUR PROPERTY COULD BE SOLD AGAINST YOUR WILL TO PAY FOR LABOR, MATERIALS, OR OTHER SERVICES THAT YOUR CONTRACTOR OR A SUBCONTRACTOR MAY HAVE FAILED TO PAY. TO PROTECT YOURSELF, YOU SHOULD STIPULATE IN THIS CONTRACT THAT BEFORE ANY PAYMENT IS MADE, YOUR CONTRACTOR IS REQUIRED TO PROVIDE YOU WITH A WRITTEN RELEASE OF LIEN FROM ANY PERSON OR COMPANY THAT HAS PROVIDED TO YOU A “NOTICE TO OWNER.” FLORIDA’S CONSTRUCTION LIEN LAW IS COMPLEX, AND IT IS RECOMMENDED THAT YOU CONSULT AN ATTORNEY.**
>
> OWNER SIGNATURE: {owner_signature_lien_notice}    DATE: {owner_signature_lien_notice_date}
>
> PRINTED NAME: {owner_full_name}

Note for the attorney: the notice tells the homeowner to "stipulate in this contract" that lien releases come before any payment. Clause C12 offers wording on lien releases. Whether the library should also offer a per-payment release clause is an attorney question.

**BUYER’S RIGHT TO CANCEL**

This is a home solicitation sale, and if you do not want the goods or services, you may cancel this agreement by providing written notice to the seller in person, by telegram, or by mail. >
> This is a home solicitation sale, and if you do not want the goods or services, you may cancel this agreement by providing written notice to the seller in person, by telegram, or by mail. This notice must indicate that you do not want the goods or services and must be delivered or postmarked before midnight of the third business day after you sign this agreement. If you cancel this agreement, the seller may not keep all or part of any cash down payment.

**What Florida adds or does differently from the FTC rule (all from the verified sections):**

| Point | FTC rule (16 CFR 429) | Florida (§501.021 to §501.055) |
|---|---|---|
| What is covered | Personal solicitation away from the seller's place of business, including after the buyer's invitation; $25 or more at the residence | Personal solicitation and consummation away from the seller's fixed location, over $25 including charges. **Excludes** "a sale, lease, or rental that results from a request for specific goods or services by the purchaser" (§501.021(1)). So a homeowner who asked for a specific job may fall outside Florida's definition while still inside the FTC rule. |
| Business day | Every day except Sunday and federal holidays | Same (§501.021(2)) |
| Deadline | Midnight of the third business day after the date of the transaction | Midnight of the third business day after the day the buyer signs (§501.025) |
| Required wording | Short bold statement near signature plus two completed NOTICE OF CANCELLATION forms, 10-point bold | One statement, exact wording, under the caption "BUYER’S RIGHT TO CANCEL" (§501.031). No form required; the buyer's notice "need not take a particular form" (§501.025) |
| How the buyer cancels | Mail or deliver the signed form or other written notice, or telegram | Written notice in person, by telegram, or by mail to the address in the agreement; mail is effective on postmark (§501.025) |
| Refund timing | 10 business days | Within 10 days (the statute says "10 days", not business days) the seller must tender back payments and any note (§501.041) |
| Work done before cancellation | Not addressed in the form | "If the seller has performed any services pursuant to a home solicitation sale prior to its cancellation, the seller is entitled to no compensation for such services." (§501.045) |
| Salesperson permit | None | A home solicitation sale permit from the clerk of the circuit court is required (§501.022), but the permit section excludes a salesperson making a visit "upon the express invitation, oral or written, of an inhabitant of the premises". That exclusion is from the permit section only. |
| Penalties | FTC Act unfair or deceptive practice | Violation of §501.025 to §501.047 is a first-degree misdemeanor (§501.055(1)) |
| Prohibited statements | Misrepresenting the right to cancel | Also may not "Allege or imply that the agreement ... is noncancelable when such is not a fact" (§501.047(4)) |

**Builder consequences (drafting choices, for the attorney to confirm):** when L5 is on, the contract's start date (C06) cannot be earlier than the day after `{cancellation_deadline_date}`, and no deposit is spent on non-returnable materials before that date. Language: customer-facing documents are English by decision of 2026-09-26. The FTC rule requires the contract and forms in the language principally used in the oral sales presentation, so if a sale is presented mainly in Portuguese, an English-only contract may not meet the rule. See attorney questions.

(1) A residential swimming pool barrier must have all of the following characteristics:
(a) The barrier must be at least 4 feet high on the outside.
(b) The barrier may not have any gaps, openings, indentations, protrusions, or structural components that could allow a young child to crawl under, squeeze through, or climb over the barrier.
(c) The barrier must be placed around the perimeter of the pool and must be separate from any fence, wall, or other enclosure surrounding the yard unless the fence, wall, or other enclosure or portion thereof is situated on the perimeter of the pool, is being used as part of the barrier, and meets the barrier requirements of this section.
(d) The barrier must be placed sufficiently away from the water’s edge to prevent a young child or medically frail elderly person who may have managed to penetrate the barrier from immediately falling into the water.
(2) The structure of an aboveground swimming pool may be used as its barrier or the barrier for such a pool may be mounted on top of its structure; however, such structure or separately mounted barrier must meet all barrier requirements of this section. In addition, any ladder or steps that are the means of access to an aboveground pool must be capable of being secured, locked, or removed to prevent access or must be surrounded by a barrier that meets the requirements of this section.
(3) Gates that provide access to swimming pools must open outward away from the pool and be self-closing and equipped with a self-latching locking device, the release mechanism of which must be located on the pool side of the gate and so placed that it cannot be reached by a young child over the top or through any opening or gap.
(4) A wall of a dwelling may serve as part of the barrier if it does not contain any door or window that opens to provide access to the swimming pool.
(5) A barrier may not be located in a way that allows any permanent structure, equipment, or similar object to be used for climbing the barrier.

This acknowledgment confirms delivery only.
>

>

**Safety feature options (§515.27(1), verbatim; the owner chooses at least one, stored as `{pool_safety_feature}`):**

> (1) In order to pass final inspection and receive a certificate of completion, a residential swimming pool must meet at least one of the following requirements relating to pool safety features:
> (a) The pool must be isolated from access to a home by an enclosure that meets the pool barrier requirements of s. 515.29;
> (b) The pool must be equipped with an approved safety pool cover;
> (c) All doors and windows providing direct access from the home to the pool must be equipped with an exit alarm that has a minimum sound pressure rating of 85 dB A at 10 feet;
> (d) All doors providing direct access from the home to the pool must be equipped with a self-closing, self-latching device with a release mechanism placed no lower than 54 inches above the floor; or
> (e) A swimming pool alarm that, when placed in a pool, sounds an alarm upon detection of an accidental or unauthorized entrance into the water. Such pool alarm must meet and be independently certified to ASTM Standard F2208, titled “Standard Safety Specification for Residential Pool Alarms,” which includes surface motion, pressure, sonar, laser, and infrared alarms. For purposes of this paragraph, the term “swimming pool alarm” does not include any swimming protection alarm device designed for individual use, such as an alarm attached to a child that sounds when the child exceeds a certain distance or becomes submerged in water.

Penalty fact (§515.27(2), verified): failing to equip a new residential pool with at least one feature is a second-degree misdemeanor, with no penalty if within 45 days the person equips the pool and attends a drowning prevention education program.

**Barrier requirements (§515.29, verbatim), printed as an exhibit when option (a) is chosen:**

> (1) A residential swimming pool barrier must have all of the following characteristics:
> (a) The barrier must be at least 4 feet high on the outside.
> (b) The barrier may not have any gaps, openings, indentations, protrusions, or structural components that could allow a young child to crawl under, squeeze through, or climb over the barrier.
> (c) The barrier must be placed around the perimeter of the pool and must be separate from any fence, wall, or other enclosure surrounding the yard unless the fence, wall, or other enclosure or portion thereof is situated on the perimeter of the pool, is being used as part of the barrier, and meets the barrier requirements of this section.
> (d) The barrier must be placed sufficiently away from the water’s edge to prevent a young child or medically frail elderly person who may have managed to penetrate the barrier from immediately falling into the water.
> (2) The structure of an aboveground swimming pool may be used as its barrier or the barrier for such a pool may be mounted on top of its structure; however, such structure or separately mounted barrier must meet all barrier requirements of this section. In addition, any ladder or steps that are the means of access to an aboveground pool must be capable of being secured, locked, or removed to prevent access or must be surrounded by a barrier that meets the requirements of this section.
> (3) Gates that provide access to swimming pools must open outward away from the pool and be self-closing and equipped with a self-latching locking device, the release mechanism of which must be located on the pool side of the gate and so placed that it cannot be reached by a young child over the top or through any opening or gap.
> (4) A wall of a dwelling may serve as part of the barrier if it does not contain any door or window that opens to provide access to the swimming pool.
> (5) A barrier may not be located in a way that allows any permanent structure, equipment, or similar object to be used for climbing the barrier.

Admin data needed: the current department drowning-prevention publication (file and version) and the "document containing the requirements of this chapter" (this draft suggests the full text of Chapter 515 as the document; the attorney confirms). clause_areas.intro_md: Verified basis: §713.06(3)(d)1 requires the contractor, when final payment becomes due, to give the owner a Contractor's Final Payment Affidavit (statutory form, sworn before a notary) listing any unpaid lienors who served a Notice to Owner; the contractor "shall have no lien or right of action against the owner" while in default for not giving it, and must deliver it at least 5 days before suing to enforce a lien. §713.20 supplies statutory lien waiver forms (from the research; the form text was not re-read). §715.12(7) (verified) lets owner and contractor agree to withhold part of each progress payment until substantial completion, then requires payment within 14 days after the listed events and a written punch list; if the contract does not set a punch-list period, the statute sets 15 days.

clause_options.pt_summary: Preço fechado que já inclui verbas (allowances) para itens que o cliente ainda vai escolher, como piso ou louças. Se a escolha custar mais, a diferença entra por aditivo; se custar menos, vira crédito. Deixa claro o que a verba cobre (só material, ou material e instalação).

clause_options.title: Fixed total price with unit prices for uncertain quantities
clause_options.owner_description: A firm total for the known work, plus a price per unit for things nobody can measure until work starts, such as rock removal or rotted subfloor. The unit prices are agreed now, so only the quantity is open.
clause_options.text: **3. Contract Price.** Owner will pay Contractor a fixed total of {contract_price} (the "Contract Price") for the Work. The following items cannot be measured before work starts and will be charged at these agreed unit prices if they are needed: {unit_price_list}. Before performing any unit-priced item, Contractor will show Owner the quantity (with photos where practical) and the total, and Owner will approve it by signed Change Order. Apart from those items, the Contract Price changes only by a Change Order signed by both parties. {tax_statement}
clause_options.pt_summary: Preço fechado para o que se conhece, mais preço por unidade já combinado para o que só aparece durante a obra (remoção de rocha, contrapiso podre). O preço unitário fica fixo agora e só a quantidade fica em aberto, sempre aprovada por aditivo com foto antes de executar.
clause_options.trailing_notes_md:
`{tax_statement}` defaults to: "The Contract Price includes all sales tax Contractor pays on materials. No sales tax is added to this Contract." This follows the research finding from Florida Department of Revenue brochure GT-800007 (lump sum and similar real property contracts: the contractor pays tax on materials and does not collect tax from the owner). The research reports this was confirmed against the DOR brochure; this session did not re-read it. A retail-sale-plus-installation job would need different wording (attorney and accountant question).

clause_options.title: Milestone schedule, receipts, no late charge
clause_options.owner_description: Payments are due at the milestones copied from the estimate. Every payment gets a written receipt. There is no interest or late fee; the remedy for non-payment is suspension under Section 13.
clause_options.text:
**4. Payments.** Owner will pay the Contract Price as follows: {payment_schedule_table}. Each payment is due on the date or at the milestone shown. Contractor will send a written request for each payment when it becomes due, and a written receipt for every payment received, showing the amount, date, method and remaining balance.

**How to pay.** Payments are accepted only by: {payment_methods_list}, made out or sent to {business_legal_name}{payment_account_hint}. Do not pay cash to any worker, and do not send payment to any person or account not listed here, even if asked. If you receive payment instructions that differ from this list, call Contractor at {business_phone} before paying.

**Late payment.** If a payment is not received by its due date, Contractor may suspend the Work as described in Section 13.
clause_options.pt_summary: Pagamentos nas etapas copiadas do orçamento, com recibo escrito de cada pagamento mostrando o saldo. Só aceita os meios listados e em nome da empresa, com o aviso de nunca pagar em dinheiro a funcionário nem para conta diferente (isso responde ao ponto 5 da auditoria: Zelle sem proteção). Não cobra juros; o remédio é a suspensão da obra.

clause_options.title: Milestone schedule with grace period and simple interest
clause_options.owner_description: Same as C04-A, plus simple interest on late payments after a grace period you set. The interest rate cannot be set above 18 percent per year.
clause_options.text:
**4. Payments.** Owner will pay the Contract Price as follows: {payment_schedule_table}. Each payment is due on the date or at the milestone shown. Contractor will send a written request for each payment when it becomes due, and a written receipt for every payment received, showing the amount, date, method and remaining balance.

**How to pay.** Payments are accepted only by: {payment_methods_list}, made out or sent to {business_legal_name}{payment_account_hint}. Do not pay cash to any worker, and do not send payment to any person or account not listed here, even if asked. If you receive payment instructions that differ from this list, call Contractor at {business_phone} before paying.

**Late payment.** A payment not received within {grace_period_days} days after its due date is late. A late payment bears simple interest at {late_interest_rate} percent per year from the due date until paid. Contractor may also suspend the Work as described in Section 13.
clause_options.fields: as C04-A plus grace_period_days, late_interest_rate (builder validation: number from 0 to 18; default 12; see note)
clause_options.pt_summary: Igual ao C04-A, mais juros simples sobre atraso depois de um prazo de carência escolhido pela empresa. A taxa nunca pode passar de 18% ao ano (teto de usura da Flórida, §687.03). Os juros só entram na terceira etapa da cobrança, nunca no lembrete.

clause_options.title: Deposit to order materials, balance at completion (short jobs)
clause_options.owner_description: A two-payment structure for short jobs: a deposit to buy materials and the balance when the work is done. It says the deposit is used for materials for this job.
clause_options.fields: deposit_amount, balance_amount, payment_schedule_note, payment_methods_list, payment_account_hint, business_phone, late_payment_sentence (either the C04-A or the C04-B late-payment sentence, picked in setup)
clause_options.pt_summary: Duas parcelas para obras curtas: sinal para comprar o material e o saldo na conclusão. Se o sinal passar de 10% do preço em imóvel residencial, o app liga o relógio do §489.126 (licença em 30 dias, início em 90 dias depois da licença).
clause_options.trailing_notes_md:
Notes for all C04 options:
- The 18 percent figure comes from §687.03 (verified): usury is interest greater than "the equivalent of 18 percent per annum simple interest" (with a higher limit only above $500,000). Whether interest on an unpaid construction invoice is a "forbearance" or "obligation" under that section, and whether §715.12's statutory interest (the §55.03 rate plus 12 percent per annum on payments due under that law) interacts with a contract rate, is an attorney question.
- The research mentions a delinquency charge of up to 5 percent "only if the contract provides for it". The statute behind that was not identified or verified, so no option offers a flat late fee. Attorney question.
- Collections follow Rafa's three steps in the app's messages (reminder on the due date, friendly follow-up the next day, contract language only on step three). The clause text is only quoted at step three.

clause_options.title: Signed change order before changed work starts
clause_options.owner_description: No extra or changed work starts until the change order is signed by both sides. The rest of the job continues while the change order waits.
clause_options.text: **5. Change Orders.** Any change to the Work, the Contract Price or the schedule must be in a written Change Order signed by Owner and Contractor. Each Change Order is a one-page addendum to this Contract that refers to this Contract by date and number and states only: what is added or removed; the Contract Price before the change; the amount of the change (a removal is a credit); the new Contract Price; any change to the payment schedule; and the effect on the schedule in working days. Contractor will not start changed or extra work until the Change Order is signed. Work not affected by the change continues. Verbal requests, texts and emails are requests only, not Change Orders. Everything in this Contract not changed by a Change Order stays the same.
clause_options.fields: none beyond the Change Order's own fields (co_number, co_date, co_description, co_price_before, co_amount, co_price_after, co_schedule_days, co_payment_change)
clause_options.pt_summary: Nenhum trabalho extra ou alterado começa sem aditivo assinado pelos dois. O aditivo tem uma página, cita o contrato original e diz só o que mudou: total anterior, valor da mudança, novo total e impacto no prazo. O resto da obra segue normalmente. Pedido por WhatsApp ou verbal é só pedido, não é aditivo.

clause_options.title: Signed change order; affected work pauses until signed
clause_options.owner_description: Same as C05-A, but any part of the job that depends on the change pauses until it is signed, and the pause time is added to the schedule.
clause_options.text: **5. Change Orders.** Any change to the Work, the Contract Price or the schedule must be in a written Change Order signed by Owner and Contractor. Each Change Order is a one-page addendum to this Contract that refers to this Contract by date and number and states only: what is added or removed; the Contract Price before the change; the amount of the change (a removal is a credit); the new Contract Price; any change to the payment schedule; and the effect on the schedule in working days. When Owner requests a change, Contractor will send the Change Order within {co_response_days} business days. Work that depends on the change stops until the Change Order is signed or the request is withdrawn in writing, and the days of that pause are added to the schedule. Verbal requests, texts and emails are requests only, not Change Orders. Everything in this Contract not changed by a Change Order stays the same.
clause_options.pt_summary: Igual ao C05-A, mas a parte da obra que depende da mudança fica parada até a assinatura, e os dias parados são somados ao prazo. A empresa se compromete a mandar o aditivo em poucos dias úteis, o que dá prazo às duas partes.

clause_options.title: Signed change order, with urgent-condition authorization
clause_options.owner_description: Same as C05-A, plus a narrow exception when something urgent is found (for example an active leak or a safety hazard): the owner can approve limited work by text or email, and the change order is signed within two business days.
clause_options.text: **5. Change Orders.** Any change to the Work, the Contract Price or the schedule must be in a written Change Order signed by Owner and Contractor. Each Change Order is a one-page addendum to this Contract that refers to this Contract by date and number and states only: what is added or removed; the Contract Price before the change; the amount of the change (a removal is a credit); the new Contract Price; any change to the payment schedule; and the effect on the schedule in working days. Contractor will not start changed or extra work until the Change Order is signed, with one exception: if a condition is found that must be addressed immediately to prevent injury or damage to the Property, Owner may authorize limited work up to {urgent_cap_amount} by text or email, and both parties will sign a Change Order for that work within 2 business days. If Owner cannot be reached, Contractor may take only the steps needed to make the area safe and will notify Owner the same day. Everything in this Contract not changed by a Change Order stays the same.
clause_options.pt_summary: Igual ao C05-A, com uma exceção estreita para urgência (vazamento ativo, risco de segurança): o cliente autoriza por mensagem um trabalho limitado a um valor máximo, e o aditivo é assinado em até 2 dias úteis. Sem contato com o cliente, a empresa só deixa a área segura e avisa no mesmo dia.

clause_options.title: Estimated dates, not guaranteed
clause_options.owner_description: Gives an estimated start and an estimated duration, and says plainly that they are estimates. Lists what must happen before work starts and which delays extend the dates.
clause_options.text:
**6. Schedule.** Contractor estimates that the Work will start on or about {estimated_start_date} and take about {estimated_duration_working_days} working days. These dates are estimates, not guarantees. Work starts after all of these have happened: this Contract is signed by both parties{cancellation_period_clause}; the deposit is received; required permits are issued; required HOA approval is received; and Owner has made the selections listed in Section 10 by their deadlines.

**Delays.** The schedule is extended, day for day, for delays Contractor does not control, including: weather that prevents safe or proper work; permit, inspection or utility company delays; manufacturer or supplier delays; concealed conditions under Section 8; Change Orders; late payments; Owner's late selections or decisions; lack of access under Section 7; work by Owner's other contractors; and natural disasters, declared emergencies or government orders. Contractor will tell Owner in writing of a delay and its expected length within {delay_notice_days} business days of knowing about it.
clause_options.fields: estimated_start_date, estimated_duration_working_days, cancellation_period_clause (filled only when L5 is on: ", and the three-business-day cancellation period has ended on {cancellation_deadline_date}"), delay_notice_days
clause_options.pt_summary: Data de início e duração estimadas, com a frase clara de que são estimativas. Lista o que precisa acontecer antes de começar (contrato assinado, sinal pago, licença, aprovação do condomínio, escolhas feitas) e quais atrasos estendem o prazo, com aviso por escrito ao cliente.

clause_options.title: Target completion date with extensions
clause_options.owner_description: Names a target completion date that Contractor commits to work toward, which moves only for the listed delays, each confirmed in writing. There is no money penalty for missing it.
clause_options.text:
**6. Schedule.** Contractor will start the Work on or about {estimated_start_date}, once the start conditions below are met, and will work toward substantial completion by {target_completion_date}. Start conditions: this Contract is signed by both parties{cancellation_period_clause}; the deposit is received; required permits are issued; required HOA approval is received; and Owner has made the selections in Section 10 by their deadlines. If a start condition is met late, the start and completion dates move by the same number of days.

**Extensions.** The completion date is extended by the number of working days lost to delays Contractor does not control, including: weather that prevents safe or proper work; permit, inspection or utility company delays; manufacturer or supplier delays; concealed conditions under Section 8; Change Orders; late payments; Owner's late selections or decisions; lack of access under Section 7; work by Owner's other contractors; and natural disasters, declared emergencies or government orders. Each extension will be stated in writing to Owner within {delay_notice_days} business days, with the new date.
clause_options.pt_summary: Dá uma data alvo de conclusão com que a empresa se compromete, que só muda pelos atrasos listados, cada um confirmado por escrito com a nova data. Não há multa por atraso. É o formato mais próximo do padrão americano de "datas explícitas e próximo passo claro".

clause_options.title: Outdoor work: weather, rain days and curing time
clause_options.owner_description: Same structure as C06-A but written for outdoor work: it counts rain days and the days after heavy rain when the ground is too wet, and it says that curing and inspection waiting times are part of the schedule, not delays.
clause_options.text:
**6. Schedule.** Contractor estimates that the Work will start on or about {estimated_start_date} and take about {estimated_duration_working_days} working days. These dates are estimates, not guarantees. Work starts after all of these have happened: this Contract is signed by both parties{cancellation_period_clause}; the deposit is received; required permits are issued; required HOA approval is received; utility locates are completed; and Owner has made the selections in Section 10 by their deadlines.

**Weather and site.** Outdoor work cannot be done safely or properly in rain, lightning, or when the ground is saturated. Each day lost to rain or lightning, and each day the ground is too wet to excavate, compact or pour, extends the schedule by one working day. Curing, drying and settling times required by the materials, and waiting for scheduled inspections, are part of the normal process. During a named storm watch or warning, Contractor may secure the site and remove loose materials and equipment, and the schedule is extended for that time.

**Other delays.** The schedule is also extended, day for day, for permit, inspection or utility delays; supplier delays; concealed conditions under Section 8; Change Orders; late payments; Owner's late selections; lack of access under Section 7; and declared emergencies or government orders. Contractor will tell Owner in writing of a delay and its expected length within {delay_notice_days} business days.
clause_options.pt_summary: Versão para obra externa (piscina e hardscape). Conta dias de chuva e dias em que o solo está encharcado como extensão de prazo, e explica que tempo de cura e espera de vistoria fazem parte do processo e não são atraso. Em alerta de tempestade nomeada, a empresa pode proteger o canteiro e o prazo se estende.
clause_options.trailing_notes_md:
**Selection deadlines (used by C06 and C10):** `{selection_deadlines_table}` lists each selection Owner must make (for example tile, grout color, plaster color, paver pattern, fixtures) with a date. It is filled in the contract builder.

clause_options.title: General access and owner responsibilities
clause_options.owner_description: The basic list of what the homeowner provides: access on working days, water and electricity, a clear work area, pets secured, and HOA approval.
clause_options.pt_summary: Lista básica do que o cliente fornece: acesso nos dias de trabalho, água e luz, área liberada, animais presos, aprovação do condomínio, chaves e códigos, e resposta às perguntas em poucos dias úteis. Se a equipe perder a viagem por falta de acesso, o prazo se estende e a viagem extra pode ser cobrada por aditivo.

clause_options.title: Occupied home (remodeling and interior work)
clause_options.owner_description: For homeowners living in the house during the work. Adds that some rooms will be out of use, that dust is controlled but not zero, and that valuables should be removed from the work area.
clause_options.fields: work_hours_start, work_hours_end, work_days, portable_toilet_location, access_instructions, owner_response_days, rooms_out_of_use, days_out_of_use
clause_options.pt_summary: Para cliente que mora na casa durante a obra. Avisa quais cômodos ficam sem uso e por quanto tempo, que haverá barreira de pó mas não pó zero, e pede que objetos de valor sejam retirados. Resolve o banheiro da equipe (da casa ou banheiro químico).

clause_options.title: Exterior work with equipment access
clause_options.owner_description: For jobs that bring machinery into the yard. Covers the access path, fence sections that may be removed and replaced, sprinkler lines, utility locates, and marking private lines like septic or irrigation.
clause_options.fields: work_hours_start, work_hours_end, work_days, access_width, access_route, fence_sections, access_instructions, owner_response_days
clause_options.pt_summary: Para obra com máquina no quintal (piscina e hardscape). Define a passagem da máquina, trechos de cerca que podem ser retirados e recolocados, e pede que o cliente mostre linhas particulares enterradas (irrigação, fossa, gás) que o serviço público de localização não marca. Deixa claro que grama e jardim não estão incluídos, salvo se constar no orçamento.

clause_options.title: General concealed conditions
clause_options.owner_description: A short, general clause for any trade. It lists the kinds of hidden problems and the stop, notify, change order process.
clause_options.text: **8. Concealed Conditions.** The Contract Price is based on conditions that can be seen during a normal visual inspection before signing. If Contractor finds a condition that was hidden or could not reasonably be known, or that differs from what the Estimate assumes, such as rot, water damage, mold, termite damage, hidden pipes or wiring, structural defects, code violations in existing work, or hazardous materials, Contractor will stop work on the affected area, notify Owner in writing with photos within {concealed_notice_days} business day(s), and propose the price and schedule effect of dealing with it. Contractor will not correct the condition without a signed Change Order. If Owner decides not to correct it, Contractor may complete the rest of the Work where that can be done properly, and is not responsible for the condition or for its effect on the Work.
clause_options.pt_summary: Cláusula geral de condições ocultas para qualquer ofício. O preço vale para o que se vê numa inspeção visual normal; se aparecer algo escondido, a empresa para aquela parte, avisa com fotos, apresenta preço e prazo, e só corrige com aditivo assinado. Se o cliente não quiser corrigir, a empresa não responde por aquilo.

clause_options.title: Below ground: pools and hardscape
clause_options.owner_description: Written for digging. Names rock, high groundwater, buried debris, old foundations, tree roots and unsuitable soil, and ties any extra work to the unit prices from C03-C when those are used.
clause_options.text: **8. Below-Ground Conditions.** Nobody can see below the surface before digging. The Contract Price assumes soil that can be excavated with standard equipment, groundwater below the planned excavation depth, and no buried obstructions. If Contractor finds rock or hard material that standard equipment cannot remove, groundwater that requires pumping (dewatering), buried debris, concrete, old foundations, septic parts, tanks, large roots, organic or unsuitable soil, or soil that requires engineering, Contractor will stop work on the affected area, notify Owner in writing with photos within {concealed_notice_days} business day(s), and propose the price and schedule effect. Where Section 3 lists a unit price for the item, that unit price applies. Contractor will not proceed with the extra work without a signed Change Order, except for steps needed to keep an open excavation safe. If an engineer or the building department requires a design change because of soil or water conditions, that change is a Change Order.
clause_options.pt_summary: Versão para escavação (piscina e hardscape). Cita rocha, lençol freático alto, entulho enterrado, fundações antigas, raízes e solo ruim. Se houver preço unitário no contrato (C03-C), ele se aplica. Exigência de engenheiro ou da prefeitura por causa do solo vira aditivo.

clause_options.title: Substrate: tile and flooring
clause_options.owner_description: Written for floors and walls. Covers what is found after removing the old floor: uneven or cracked slab, damaged subfloor, moisture, and old adhesive or flooring layers that may contain asbestos.
clause_options.text: **8. Substrate Conditions.** The Contract Price assumes the surface under the existing floor or wall covering is sound, dry and within the flatness the new material requires, needing no more than {leveling_included} of leveling. If, after removal, Contractor finds cracks in the slab, an uneven or damaged subfloor, loose or rotted wood, excess moisture, more than one layer of old flooring, or old adhesive or flooring that may contain asbestos, Contractor will stop work on the affected area, notify Owner in writing with photos within {concealed_notice_days} business day(s), and propose the price and schedule effect of correcting it. Where Section 3 lists a unit price, that unit price applies. Contractor will not proceed without a signed Change Order. Contractor does not test for or remove asbestos; if suspected material is found, work in that area stops until Owner has it tested and, if needed, removed by a qualified company. If Owner chooses not to correct a substrate condition, the manufacturer's warranty and Contractor's warranty do not cover problems caused by that condition, such as cracked tile or grout, lippage or hollow sounds.
clause_options.pt_summary: Versão para piso e revestimento. O preço supõe contrapiso firme, seco e nivelado dentro de um limite. Se ao remover o piso antigo aparecer laje trincada, contrapiso podre, umidade, várias camadas antigas ou cola que pode ter amianto, a empresa para, avisa com fotos e só segue com aditivo. Se o cliente não corrigir, a garantia não cobre os problemas causados por isso.

clause_options.title: Inside walls and older homes: remodeling and general services
clause_options.owner_description: Written for opening walls, ceilings and cabinets, and for painting. Adds outdated wiring or plumbing that must be brought to code once exposed, the surface condition of what will be painted, and lead-safe rules for homes built before 1978.
clause_options.pt_summary: Versão para reforma e pintura. Ao abrir paredes pode aparecer podridão, mofo, cupim, fiação ou encanamento fora do código, que a prefeitura pode exigir corrigir. Define a preparação de superfície incluída na pintura. Para casas anteriores a 1978, a empresa entrega o folheto federal sobre chumbo, pega o recibo assinado e trabalha com práticas seguras (regra RRP da EPA).
clause_options.trailing_notes_md:
- Source note: 40 CFR 745.84(a) (read on ecfr.gov) requires the firm, no more than 60 days before renovation in target housing, to give the owner the pamphlet and obtain a written acknowledgment or a certificate of mailing at least 7 days before the renovation. The 1978 cutoff comes from the federal definition of target housing, which was not re-read in this session. Whether the firm itself must hold EPA certification to use this clause is an attorney and compliance question.

clause_options.title: Contractor pulls permits; Owner records the Notice of Commencement

Permit fees {permit_fee_treatment}. Owner will sign the permit documents that require the owner's signature within {owner_response_days} business days of receiving them. {noc_sentence} Contractor will not start work that requires a permit before the permit is issued, and will not request the first inspection until {noc_first_inspection_sentence}. Permit fees {permit_fee_treatment}. Owner will sign the permit documents that require the owner's signature within {owner_response_days} business days of receiving them. clause_options.title: No permit required
clause_options.owner_description: For work the business has determined needs no permit under the local code. It says so, and says that if the building department decides otherwise, the permit becomes a change order.

Permits and Inspections.** Based on the Estimate and the local building code as Contractor understands it, the Work does not require a building permit in {permit_jurisdiction}. clause_options.pt_summary: Para serviço que a empresa entende que não precisa de licença no município. Se a prefeitura exigir, a empresa tira a licença e a taxa e as mudanças entram por aditivo. Atenção: sem licença, o relógio do §489.126 (se o sinal passar de 10%) conta só o início de obra.

clause_options.title: General selections and substitutions
clause_options.owner_description: Sets selection deadlines, allows substitution only with an equal or better product and the homeowner's written OK, and covers backorders.
clause_options.text: **10. Materials and Selections.** Owner will make the selections listed here by the dates shown: {selection_deadlines_table}. A late selection extends the schedule. Once Owner approves a selection in writing and Contractor orders it, changing it is a Change Order, including any restocking fee the supplier charges. If a specified product is discontinued or backordered for more than {backorder_days} days, Contractor will propose an equal or better substitute in writing, and will not use it without Owner's written approval. If Owner prefers to wait for the original product, the schedule is extended. Materials remain Contractor's property until paid for, and leftover materials that Owner paid for are left with Owner unless Owner asks Contractor to remove them.
clause_options.pt_summary: Define prazos para as escolhas do cliente; escolha atrasada estende o prazo e mudança depois de pedido o material vira aditivo (com taxa de devolução do fornecedor). Substituição só por produto igual ou melhor e com aprovação por escrito. Sobra de material pago fica com o cliente.

clause_options.title: Tile and natural stone: lots, variation, grout and attic stock
clause_options.owner_description: Adds what is specific to tile and stone: color differences between production lots, natural variation in stone, grout color appearance, and extra tile left for future repairs.
clause_options.text:
**10. Materials and Selections.** Owner will make the selections listed here by the dates shown: {selection_deadlines_table}. A late selection extends the schedule. Once Owner approves a selection in writing and Contractor orders it, changing it is a Change Order, including any restocking fee the supplier charges.

**Lots and variation.** Tile is made in production lots (dye lots), and color and size can vary between lots. Contractor will try to order the full quantity from one lot; if the supplier cannot, Contractor will tell Owner before installing. Natural stone, and porcelain made to look like stone or wood, varies in color, veining and texture from piece to piece and from any sample or showroom display. That variation is a characteristic of the material, not a defect.

**Grout.** Grout color on the wall or floor can look different from the color chart because of lighting, joint width and the tile around it. Owner will approve the grout color in writing: {grout_color}. Slight shade variation in grout is not a defect.

**Extra material.** The Estimate includes {overage_percent} percent extra for cuts and breakage. Contractor will leave {attic_stock_quantity} of unused tile with Owner for future repairs. Contractor cannot guarantee that the same tile will be available later.

**Backorders.** If a specified product is discontinued or backordered for more than {backorder_days} days, Contractor will propose an equal or better substitute in writing and will not use it without Owner's written approval.
clause_options.pt_summary: Específico de cerâmica e pedra: variação de cor entre lotes de fabricação, variação natural da pedra, rejunte que parece diferente da cartela, porcentagem de sobra para corte e quebra, e peças que ficam com o cliente para reparo futuro. Variação natural não é defeito, e isso fica escrito antes da obra.

clause_options.title: Pools and hardscape: finishes, pavers and natural products
clause_options.owner_description: Adds what is specific to pool finishes and outdoor surfaces: plaster and pebble color variation, paver lot and shade variation, travertine characteristics, and efflorescence.
clause_options.text:
**10. Materials and Selections.** Owner will make the selections listed here by the dates shown: {selection_deadlines_table}. A late selection extends the schedule. Once Owner approves a selection in writing and Contractor orders it, changing it is a Change Order, including any restocking fee.

**Finishes and natural products.** Pool interior finishes (plaster, quartz, pebble) cure to a color that can vary from samples and can show mottling or shade differences, which change with water chemistry and sunlight. Pavers, travertine and natural stone vary in shade between pallets and from samples; Contractor will blend pallets during installation. Travertine has natural holes and pits. A white haze on concrete pavers or masonry (efflorescence) can appear as the material cures. These are characteristics of the materials, not defects.

**Extra material.** Contractor will leave {attic_stock_quantity} of unused pavers, coping or tile with Owner for future repairs. Contractor cannot guarantee that the same product or shade will be available later.

**Backorders.** If a specified product or equipment model is discontinued or backordered for more than {backorder_days} days, Contractor will propose an equal or better substitute in writing and will not use it without Owner's written approval.
clause_options.pt_summary: Específico de piscina e área externa: acabamento da piscina (reboco, quartzo, pebble) varia de cor com a cura e com a química da água, pavers e travertino variam entre paletes, o travertino tem furinhos naturais e a eflorescência branca pode aparecer. Tudo isso fica declarado como característica do material.

clause_options.title: Owner-supplied materials
clause_options.owner_description: Used when the homeowner buys some materials. The homeowner is responsible for the right quantity arriving on time; labor for handling problems with those materials is extra, and the workmanship warranty covers installation only.
clause_options.text: **10. Materials and Selections.** Owner will make the selections listed here by the dates shown: {selection_deadlines_table}. Owner will supply these materials: {owner_supplied_items}, in the quantities Contractor specifies, delivered to the Property by {owner_materials_due_date}. Contractor will inspect them on delivery and tell Owner of visible damage or shortages. Delays caused by late, short or damaged owner-supplied materials extend the schedule, and a return trip caused by them may be charged by Change Order. Contractor's warranty covers Contractor's installation of owner-supplied materials, not the materials themselves. For materials Contractor supplies, if a product is discontinued or backordered for more than {backorder_days} days, Contractor will propose an equal or better substitute in writing and will not use it without Owner's written approval.

A garantia da empresa cobre só a instalação, não o material comprado pelo cliente.

clause_options.title: One-year workmanship warranty
clause_options.owner_description: Contractor warrants its workmanship for one year from completion. Manufacturer warranties pass to the homeowner. Lists exclusions and the claim steps.
clause_options.text:
**11. Warranty.** Contractor warrants that the Work will be free from defects in workmanship for {warranty_months_workmanship} months from the date of substantial completion (the "Warranty Period"). If a defect in workmanship appears during the Warranty Period, Contractor will repair it, or at Contractor's choice replace the defective part of the Work, at no charge. This is Contractor's only warranty; it does not promise any refund.

**Manufacturer warranties.** Products and equipment carry their manufacturers' warranties, which Contractor will pass to Owner at completion along with registration information. Contractor does not add its own warranty to manufactured products, but will install them according to the manufacturer's instructions.

**Not covered.** The warranty does not cover: normal wear; damage from misuse, neglect, lack of the maintenance described in the care instructions Contractor provides, accidents, storms, flooding, settling of the ground or structure not caused by the Work, or pests; work or repairs by anyone other than Contractor; owner-supplied materials; natural variation in materials described in Section 10; conditions Owner chose not to correct under Section 8; and minor hairline cracks in concrete, grout or plaster that do not affect function.

**How to make a claim.** Owner will notify Contractor in writing at {warranty_contact} within {warranty_notice_days} days of noticing a problem, with photos if possible, and will give Contractor access to inspect within {warranty_inspect_days} business days. Contractor will tell Owner in writing whether the problem is covered and, if covered, schedule the repair. Owner will give Contractor the chance to inspect and repair before hiring anyone else to fix a covered item.

**ANY CLAIMS FOR CONSTRUCTION DEFECTS ARE SUBJECT TO THE NOTICE AND CURE PROVISIONS OF CHAPTER 558, FLORIDA STATUTES.**

clause_options.title: Final payment at substantial completion, small punch-list holdback
clause_options.owner_description: The final payment is due when the job is substantially complete, except a small amount the homeowner may hold until the punch list is done. The affidavit and lien releases are delivered with the final invoice.
clause_options.text:
**12. Completion and Final Payment.** The Work is "substantially complete" when it can be used for its intended purpose{final_inspection_clause}, even if minor items remain. Contractor will notify Owner in writing when the Work is substantially complete and walk through it with Owner within {walkthrough_days} business days. At the walkthrough, Owner and Contractor will sign a written punch list of remaining items. Owner may hold back {punch_holdback_amount} from the final payment until the punch list is finished; Contractor will finish the punch list within {punch_completion_days} business days, unless an item depends on a backordered product. Items not on the signed punch list, other than hidden defects, are covered by the warranty in Section 11 rather than the punch list.

**Final payment documents.** With the final invoice, Contractor will give Owner: (1) the Contractor's Final Payment Affidavit required by section 713.06, Florida Statutes; (2) releases of lien from Contractor and from each subcontractor or supplier that served Owner with a Notice to Owner, for amounts paid so far, with final releases on receipt of final payment; (3) manufacturer warranties and care instructions; and (4) any inspection approvals or certificates of completion. Owner is not required to make the final payment until item (1) is delivered. The final payment, less any punch-list holdback, is due within {final_payment_days} days after these documents are delivered.
clause_options.fields: final_inspection_clause (", has passed final inspection," when permitted, empty otherwise), walkthrough_days, punch_holdback_amount, punch_completion_days, final_payment_days
clause_options.pt_summary: O pagamento final vence na conclusão substancial, e o cliente pode segurar um valor pequeno até terminar a lista de pendências (punch list) assinada pelos dois. Com a fatura final a empresa entrega a declaração juramentada de pagamento final (Final Payment Affidavit, §713.06), as liberações de ônus (lien releases), as garantias e as aprovações. Sem a declaração, o cliente não é obrigado a pagar o final.

clause_options.title: Final payment at final completion
clause_options.trades: all (most used by tile, general and small hardscape jobs)

Owner will list in writing, at the walkthrough, any items Owner believes are incomplete or not in accordance with this Contract. Contractor will correct listed items that are its responsibility within {punch_completion_days} business days. The Work is "complete" when those items are corrected{final_inspection_clause}.

**Final payment documents.** With the final invoice, Contractor will give Owner: (1) the Contractor's Final Payment Affidavit required by section 713.06, Florida Statutes; (2) releases of lien from Contractor and from each subcontractor or supplier that served Owner with a Notice to Owner, with final releases on receipt of final payment; (3) manufacturer warranties and care instructions; and (4) any inspection approvals. Owner is not required to make the final payment until item (1) is delivered. The final payment is due within {final_payment_days} days after the Work is complete and these documents are delivered. Owner may not withhold payment for items not listed at the walkthrough; those are handled under the warranty in Section 11.
clause_options.pt_summary: O pagamento final vence só quando tudo estiver pronto, inclusive as pendências. Não há retenção porque nada fica em aberto. O cliente precisa apontar as pendências por escrito na vistoria final; o que não foi apontado ali vai para a garantia, não serve para segurar o pagamento.

clause_options.title: Retainage on each progress payment
clause_options.owner_description: The homeowner holds back a percentage of each progress payment until substantial completion, then pays it after the punch list, on the timing in Florida's prompt payment law.
clause_options.text:
**12. Retainage, Completion and Final Payment.** Owner may withhold {retainage_percent} percent of each progress payment ("retainage") until the Work is substantially complete. The Work is "substantially complete" when it can be used for its intended purpose{final_inspection_clause}. Within {punchlist_submit_days} days after substantial completion, Owner will give Contractor a written punch list. Owner will pay the retainage and any remaining balance within 14 days after Contractor substantially completes the items on that punch list, as provided in section 715.12, Florida Statutes.

**Final payment documents.** With the final invoice, Contractor will give Owner: (1) the Contractor's Final Payment Affidavit required by section 713.06, Florida Statutes; (2) releases of lien from Contractor and from each subcontractor or supplier that served Owner with a Notice to Owner; (3) manufacturer warranties and care instructions; and (4) any inspection approvals or certificates of completion. Owner is not required to make the final payment until item (1) is delivered.

clause_options.pt_summary: O cliente retém uma porcentagem de cada parcela até a conclusão substancial e paga a retenção 14 dias depois de a empresa concluir a lista de pendências, conforme a lei de pagamento pontual da Flórida (§715.12). Mais comum em obras grandes.

clause_options.title: Asymmetric: Contractor may suspend or terminate for non-payment or access; Owner for cause
clause_options.owner_description: The business can pause work after a short written notice if a payment is late or access is denied, and can end the contract if that continues. The homeowner can end the contract if the business fails to perform and does not fix it after notice. Neither side can end it just by changing their mind.
clause_options.text:
**13. Suspension and Termination.**
**Suspension by Contractor.** If a payment is more than {suspension_trigger_days} days late, or Owner does not provide access under Section 7, Contractor may suspend the Work after giving Owner {suspension_notice_days} business days' written notice. The schedule is extended for the suspension, and Owner will pay Contractor's documented costs of demobilizing and remobilizing.
**Termination by Contractor.** If the cause of a suspension is not corrected within {contractor_termination_days} days after the suspension starts, Contractor may terminate this Contract by letter stating the reason, sent by certified mail, return receipt requested, to Owner's address in this Contract, with a copy by email.
**Termination by Owner.** If Contractor fails to perform the Work as this Contract requires, Owner may give Contractor written notice describing the failure. If Contractor does not begin to correct it within {owner_cure_days} business days after receiving the notice and diligently complete the correction, Owner may terminate this Contract by a second written notice.
**Payment on termination.** On any termination, Owner will pay Contractor for Work performed up to the termination date, valued on the basis of the Contract Price and the payment schedule, plus materials ordered for this Work that cannot be returned or cancelled (which become Owner's property), less payments already made. If Owner terminates under this section, Owner may deduct Owner's reasonable, documented cost to correct Contractor's defective work. Contractor will give Owner the Contractor's Final Payment Affidavit and releases of lien for amounts paid.
clause_options.pt_summary: Rescisão assimétrica do Pr. Rafael. A empresa pode suspender com aviso por escrito se o pagamento atrasar ou o acesso for negado, e rescindir se continuar, por carta registrada com aviso de recebimento (é a forma descrita no §489.126). O cliente pode rescindir por falha da empresa depois de aviso e prazo para corrigir. Ninguém rescinde só por mudar de ideia. Na rescisão, paga-se o trabalho feito e o material que não pode ser devolvido.

clause_options.title: Asymmetric, plus Owner termination for convenience with a fee
clause_options.owner_description: Same as C13-A, but the homeowner may also end the contract without a reason, by paying for work done, non-returnable materials, and a fixed termination amount that you set. The termination amount must be written as a real estimate of your costs.
clause_options.text: **Termination by Owner without cause.** Owner may also terminate this Contract for any reason by written notice to Contractor. In that case, in addition to the payment on termination above, Owner will pay {convenience_fee_description}, which the parties agree is a reasonable estimate of Contractor's costs of scheduling, crew commitment and lost opportunity that are hard to calculate at the time of signing. This paragraph does not apply during the three-business-day cancellation period, if any, in the Notice of Cancellation attached to this Contract.
clause_options.fields: as C13-A plus convenience_fee_description (e.g. "{convenience_fee_percent} percent of the unpaid Contract Price")
clause_options.pt_summary: Igual ao C13-A, mas o cliente também pode rescindir sem motivo, pagando o trabalho feito, o material que não volta e um valor fixo de rescisão definido pela empresa como estimativa real dos custos. Nunca se aplica durante os 3 dias úteis de cancelamento. Se esse valor é exigível na Flórida é pergunta para o advogado.

clause_options.title: Mutual for-cause termination only
clause_options.owner_description: Both sides have the same rights: either may end the contract only for the other's serious failure after written notice and a cure period. The business keeps the right to suspend for non-payment.
clause_options.text:
**13. Suspension and Termination.**
**Suspension for non-payment or access.** If a payment is more than {suspension_trigger_days} days late, or Owner does not provide access under Section 7, Contractor may suspend the Work after giving Owner {suspension_notice_days} business days' written notice. The schedule is extended for the suspension.
**Termination for cause.** If either party materially fails to perform this Contract, the other may give written notice describing the failure. If the failure is not corrected within {mutual_cure_days} days after the notice is received, the party that gave notice may terminate this Contract by a second written notice. A termination notice from Contractor will be sent by certified mail, return receipt requested, to Owner's address in this Contract, with a copy by email.
**Payment on termination.** On any termination, Owner will pay Contractor for Work performed up to the termination date, valued on the basis of the Contract Price and the payment schedule, plus materials ordered for this Work that cannot be returned or cancelled (which become Owner's property), less payments already made and less Owner's reasonable, documented cost to correct Contractor's defective work if Owner terminated for cause. Contractor will give Owner the Contractor's Final Payment Affidavit and releases of lien for amounts paid.
clause_options.pt_summary: Direitos iguais para os dois lados: só se rescinde por falha grave da outra parte, depois de aviso e prazo para corrigir. A empresa mantém o direito de suspender por falta de pagamento. É a versão menos assimétrica, oferecida para quem prefere igualdade formal.

clause_options.title: Package A: negotiation, mediation, then court in the property's county
clause_options.owner_description: Talk first, then a mediator, then a lawsuit in the county court or circuit court where the property is. Each side pays its own lawyer unless the court orders otherwise by law.
clause_options.text: **14. Disputes.** If a dispute arises under this Contract, the parties will first meet (in person or by video) within {negotiation_days} days after either gives written notice of the dispute, to try to resolve it. If it is not resolved within {negotiation_days} days after that meeting, either party may request mediation by a Florida Supreme Court certified mediator in {property_county} County, with the mediator's fee shared equally. If mediation does not resolve the dispute within {mediation_days} days after the request, either party may file suit. Any suit will be filed in the state courts for {property_county} County, Florida. Each party will pay its own attorney's fees and costs, except as a statute or court rule provides otherwise. Claims for construction defects are also subject to Chapter 558, Florida Statutes. Nothing in this section prevents Contractor from recording or enforcing a claim of lien within the time the law allows, or either party from seeking emergency relief from a court.
clause_options.pt_summary: Pacote A: conversa, depois mediador certificado, depois ação judicial no condado do imóvel. Cada parte paga seu advogado. A empresa mantém o direito de registrar o lien no prazo legal, que não espera a mediação.

clause_options.title: Package B: negotiation, mediation, then binding arbitration
clause_options.owner_description: Talk first, then a mediator, then a private arbitrator whose decision is final instead of a court and jury. The arbitration is held in the property's county; fees are split as the package states.
clause_options.text:
**14. Disputes.** If a dispute arises under this Contract, the parties will first meet (in person or by video) within {negotiation_days} days after either gives written notice of the dispute, to try to resolve it. If it is not resolved within {negotiation_days} days after that meeting, either party may request mediation by a Florida Supreme Court certified mediator in {property_county} County, with the mediator's fee shared equally. If mediation does not resolve the dispute within {mediation_days} days after the request, the dispute will be decided by binding arbitration before a single arbitrator under {arbitration_rules}, held in {property_county} County, Florida. The arbitrator's decision is final and may be entered as a judgment in court. **BY AGREEING TO ARBITRATION, OWNER AND CONTRACTOR EACH GIVE UP THE RIGHT TO HAVE THE DISPUTE DECIDED BY A JUDGE OR JURY IN COURT.** {arbitration_fee_allocation} Claims for construction defects are also subject to Chapter 558, Florida Statutes. Nothing in this section prevents Contractor from recording or enforcing a claim of lien within the time the law allows, or either party from seeking emergency relief from a court. Claims within the small claims limit may be brought in small claims court instead of arbitration.

clause_options.pt_summary: Pacote B: conversa, mediador e depois arbitragem obrigatória, com árbitro privado cuja decisão é final, sem juiz nem júri. O cliente rubrica ao lado da cláusula. Causas pequenas podem ir ao juizado de pequenas causas. As regras e a divisão de custos da arbitragem são definidas pelo advogado.

clause_options.text:
**14. Disputes.** If a dispute arises under this Contract, the parties will first meet (in person or by video) within {negotiation_days} days after either gives written notice of the dispute, to try to resolve it. If it is not resolved within {negotiation_days} days after that meeting, either party may request mediation by a Florida Supreme Court certified mediator in {property_county} County, with the mediator's fee shared equally. Nothing in this section prevents Contractor from recording or enforcing a claim of lien within the time the law allows, or either party from seeking emergency relief from a court.

clause_options.pt_summary: Pacote C: mesmo caminho do A, mas quem ganhar na justiça recebe honorários advocatícios razoáveis da outra parte, e as duas partes renunciam ao júri (quem decide é o juiz). O cliente rubrica ao lado da renúncia ao júri.

clause_options.title: Liability limited to the Contract Price; no indirect damages
clause_options.owner_description: Caps what the business can owe for claims under the contract at the contract price, and excludes indirect losses like lost rent or hotel costs. Personal injury, property damage caused by the business's negligence, and intentional wrongdoing are not capped.
clause_options.text: **15. Liability and Insurance.** {insurance_statement} Except for bodily injury, damage to property other than the Work caused by Contractor's negligence, and fraud or intentional misconduct, Contractor's total liability for all claims arising from this Contract will not exceed the Contract Price. Neither party is liable to the other for indirect or consequential losses, such as loss of use, lost rent, temporary housing, or lost profits, except as this Contract states otherwise. Owner is responsible for insuring the Property, including the Work as it is installed, under Owner's homeowner's policy.
clause_options.pt_summary: Limita a responsabilidade da empresa ao valor do contrato e exclui perdas indiretas (aluguel perdido, hotel, lucro cessante). Não limita lesão corporal, dano à propriedade por negligência nem fraude. Seguro só aparece se houver certificado válido cadastrado; nunca se escreve "segurado" ou "bonded" sem documento. Responde ao ponto 7 da auditoria (falta de limite de responsabilidade).

clause_options.title: No liability cap; insurance statement only
clause_options.owner_description: No limit on liability. The clause only states the insurance on file (if any) and that the homeowner insures the property.
clause_options.text: **15. Insurance.** {insurance_statement} Owner is responsible for insuring the Property, including the Work as it is installed, under Owner's homeowner's policy.
clause_options.pt_summary: Sem limite de responsabilidade. Só informa o seguro que estiver cadastrado (se houver) e que o cliente segura o imóvel pelo seguro residencial dele. É a versão mais curta.

clause_options.title: Liability limited to the amount paid for the affected part of the Work
clause_options.owner_description: A narrower cap than C15-A: liability for a claim is limited to what the homeowner paid for the part of the job the claim is about. Same carve-outs and indirect-loss exclusion as C15-A.
clause_options.text: **15. Liability and Insurance.** {insurance_statement} Except for bodily injury, damage to property other than the Work caused by Contractor's negligence, and fraud or intentional misconduct, Contractor's liability for any claim arising from this Contract will not exceed the amount Owner paid for the part of the Work the claim concerns, as shown in the Estimate or a Change Order. Neither party is liable to the other for indirect or consequential losses, such as loss of use, lost rent, temporary housing, or lost profits, except as this Contract states otherwise. Owner is responsible for insuring the Property, including the Work as it is installed, under Owner's homeowner's policy.
clause_options.pt_summary: Limite mais estreito que o C15-A: a responsabilidade por uma reclamação fica limitada ao que o cliente pagou pela parte da obra em questão. clause_options.title: Standard general terms
clause_options.owner_description: The standard closing terms: this contract plus its attachments is the whole agreement, how notices are sent, electronic signatures, what happens if one part is invalid, and Florida law.
clause_options.text:
**19. General Terms.**
**Entire agreement.** This Contract, the Estimate, the attachments listed below and any signed Change Orders are the entire agreement between Owner and Contractor. They replace all earlier discussions, messages and proposals. Only a written document signed by both parties can change this Contract. Attachments: {attachments_list}.
**Notices.** Formal notices under this Contract (delay, concealed condition, suspension, termination, warranty claim, dispute) must be in writing and sent to the addresses in Section 1, by email and by one of: hand delivery, certified mail, or a nationally recognized courier. A termination notice from Contractor is also sent by certified mail, return receipt requested. Day-to-day scheduling messages may be sent by text or messaging app.
**Electronic signatures and records.** Before signing, Owner consented to receive and sign this Contract electronically on the consent screen that is part of the signing record. Electronic signatures on this Contract, its notices and Change Orders have the same effect as handwritten signatures under the federal Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act and section 668.50, Florida Statutes. Each party will receive a complete copy of the signed Contract. Owner may request a paper copy at no charge by contacting Contractor.
**Severability.** If any part of this Contract is found unenforceable, the rest remains in effect, and the unenforceable part will be applied to the greatest extent the law allows.
**Governing law.** Florida law governs this Contract.
**No waiver.** Accepting a late payment or allowing a delay once does not waive the right to insist on the terms later.
**Assignment.** Neither party may assign this Contract without the other's written consent, except that Contractor may use licensed subcontractors for parts of the Work and remains responsible for their work.
clause_options.pt_summary: Cláusulas finais padrão: o contrato com anexos e aditivos é o acordo inteiro, como enviar avisos formais (e-mail mais entrega pessoal, carta registrada ou courier), assinatura eletrônica com consentimento prévio (ESIGN e lei UETA da Flórida, §668.50), cópia ao cliente, divisibilidade e lei da Flórida. Subcontratados licenciados são permitidos com a empresa respondendo por eles.
